title: Wrapping up the tape and planning to discuss idols and clubs
summary: Allen ends the session as the tape runs out, deferring talk of Jones's idols and the Skunk Hall and Pyramid Club for next time.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Why don't we call it to a halt? I think the tape's about to run out. And I hate to ask you who your idols were then. And get into the Skunk Hall and the Club Pyramid Ballas. If we've got to talk about them, we ought to talk about them. Skunk Hall and the Pyramid Club.
Talk about them at length. Let's run it back and see how it sounds.
